consequences: Ten quick holder updates log 10 rows instead of 20. A lock's lease may trail its claim's lease by up to a minute; the next holder write after that renews it.
context: Review WP3.1: every holder write renewed each task lock and logged one activity row per lock, so a burst of updates doubled the log and held the write lock longer. The review asked whether a lease-only renewal needs an activity row.
decision: Owner decision: keep the rule that every write logs. No quiet write path and no ADR. renewTaskLocks skips the write when the lease would move by less than LOCK_RENEW_STEP_MS (one minute).
title: Lock lease renewals stay logged; renewals under a minute are skipped
